summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized tests covering valid and invalid shapes, literal TypeError, None/string handling, and graph immutability. Tests run with the shared venv: 40 passed (new tests plus test/test_path.py). Not verified: black, isort, and mypy are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting and type-ignore placement were checked by hand only. Nothing committed.
